item.title: Chrome is removing XSLT on November 17, 2026: what breaks and what to do
item.description:
Update, 22 November 2026: Chrome 158 shipped on 17 November and XSLT is now gone. If a page shows raw XML or “This document cannot be formatted as intended”, see how to view it again or install the XSLT Polyfill extension. The migration advice below still applies to site owners.

Quick answer: Chrome removes built-in XSLT support in version 158, shipping November 17, 2026, with deprecation warnings already appearing since Chrome 142–143 (official announcement). Both the XSLTProcessor JavaScript API and <?xml-stylesheet?> processing instructions stop working. Firefox and WebKit have signalled they will follow. Your migration options are a WASM polyfill, server-side transformation, or build-time precompilation — and you can check whether your stylesheets run correctly outside the browser right now, before you pick one.
